articles.title: Turn Company Autopilot On or Off
articles.summary: Controls the Company Autopilot mode for the tenant.
steps: Open Autopilot Settings.
Locate Company Autopilot.
Choose On to activate Company Autopilot or Off to disable it.
Review the status label and verify that the page shows the intended state.
Click Save Settings to save the change.
warnings: If the page is in View Only mode, the On/Off controls and Save Settings button cannot be changed.

articles.title: Turn Broker Autopilot On or Off
articles.summary: Controls Broker Autopilot when a broker contract is enabled for the tenant.
steps: Open Autopilot Settings.
Locate Broker Autopilot.
Choose On to activate Broker Autopilot or Off to disable it.
Click Save Settings.
Verify that the saved status matches the selected mode.
warnings: Broker Autopilot is shown only when the tenant has an enabled broker contract.

articles.title: Turn Broker Shared Autopilot On or Off
articles.summary: Controls automatic broker shared processing when Broker Shared is available.
steps: Open Autopilot Settings.
Locate Broker Shared Autopilot.
Choose On to activate it or Off to disable it.
Click Save Settings.
Verify the saved status after the page refreshes the settings.
warnings: Broker Shared Autopilot is shown only when Broker Shared is available for the tenant.

articles.title: Understand Autopilot Visibility and View Only Mode
articles.summary: Explains why some Autopilot cards may be hidden and why controls may be disabled.
steps: Open Autopilot Settings.
Check which Autopilot cards are visible.
Company Autopilot remains available as the base Autopilot option.
Broker Autopilot appears only when the broker contract capability is enabled.
Broker Shared Autopilot appears only when Broker Shared is available.
If Save Settings shows View Only, the current user can review the settings but cannot change them.

articles.title: How to Save Autopilot Settings
articles.summary: Save changes made to the Autopilot switches/modes.
steps: Open Autopilot Mode.
Change the available Company, Broker, or Broker Shared settings.
Click Save Settings.
Verify the saved status shown on the page.
